description: Issue #27: real-hardware check of 05-12 steps 12-13, marked unverified since PR #26. Probe A: DSPPGMREF (*OUTFILE and *PRINT) on TK0100 before/after CRTDUPOBJ (library column, LASTCD row); DSPPGM DETAIL(*SRVPGM) on the OPM program (message ID if it fails); FNDSTRPDM variants (OPTION/CASE) through qsh system(), a DSPCMD listing of its keywords, and a qsh grep fallback over QRPGSRC/QDDSSRC members. Probe B (P0512B, runs in the wrapper job): RMVLIBLE of the private library while it is still the current library, then SETENV *PRD followed by RMVLIBLE, recording the library list into VFYCUR at each stage; an unqualified RTVOBJD *LIBL/TK0100D afterwards shows where the display file resolves. A non-interactive CALL of TK0100 is deliberately NOT attempted (display file in a batch job; an unanswered inquiry would hang the whole connection and lose the results) - that part stays V3. Also self-tests the new 'after' sh step (verify/lib/batch.mjs): RUNSQLSTM SRCSTMF('$HOME/...') from qsh with DFTRDBCOL. Safety: CHGCURLIB to the dev library first (CURSET); the only changes made in the private library area are job attributes (current library, library list), no object is created/changed/deleted there; all objects go to &LIB/&LIB2; TK0100/TK0100D copies in &LIB2 are removed at the end.

steps.label: FND2
steps.cmd: system "FNDSTRPDM FILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) MBR(*ALL) STRING('tokuim') OPTION(*NONE) CASE(*IGNORE)" 2>&1

steps.label: MKCUR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYCUR (TAG VARCHAR(40), ORD INT, LIB VARCHAR(20), TYPE VARCHAR(10))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: REC0
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYCUR SELECT ''A0-AFTER-CHGCURLIB'', ORDINAL_POSITION, SCHEMA_NAME, TYPE FROM QSYS2.LIBRARY_LIST_INFO') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MKLASTCD
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/LASTCD) OBJTYPE(*DTAARA)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTDTAARA DTAARA(&LIB/LASTCD) TYPE(*CHAR) LEN(6) VALUE('C00000') TEXT('verify harness 05-12 probe'))

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('verify harness spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: MK1
steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSG('MARK REFPRT: DSPPGMREF *PRINT on the duplicate')

steps.label: CAP1
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: MK2
steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSG('MARK SRVPGM: DSPPGM DETAIL(*SRVPGM) on the OPM duplicate')

steps.label: MK3
steps.cmd: SNDPGMMSG MSG('MARK DSPCMD: DSPCMD FNDSTRPDM listing')

steps.label: CAP2
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, ORD, LIB, TYPE FROM &LIB/VFYCUR ORDER BY TAG, ORD
SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFYSPL FETCH FIRST 400 ROWS ONLY
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('TK0100','TK0100D','LASTCD') ORDER BY OBJNAME
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('TK0100','TK0100D','LASTCD','P0512B') ORDER BY OBJNAME
